title: Why is the diagnosis of cerebral stroke initially not recognized in patients at a standard and specialized care hospital with teleneurological services: a descriptive analysis
summary: Unser Ziel ist es herauszufinden, warum Patienten mit einem zerebralen Schlaganfall in der Zentralen Notaufnahme nicht oder nicht zeitnah richtig diagnostiziert werden und dadurch nicht der teleneurologischen Untersuchung und ggf. einer zeitnahen Therapie zugeführt werden

interventions.name: Descriptive retrospective analysis of 238 patients who were not correctly diagnosed in a timely manner, in a cohort of 1762 patients diagnosed with a stroke or TIA between 01.06.2017 and 31.12.2025.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients who were diagnosed with a cerebral stroke belatedly after admission using cMRI or CCT, without this diagnosis having been initially made and therefore without a teleneurological examination being carried out in the emergency department.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients who were deliberately not adequately diagnosed neurologically due to palliative care, lack of therapeutic intervention, or other reasons.
All patients diagnosed with a cerebral stroke immediately upon admission to the emergency department and referred for a teleneurological examination in the emergency department.
